sources.T: REON statement to the PeakSure team (hackathon channel)
sources.W: REON_WHO_WE_ARE.pdf as transcribed in PeakSure-Science-Addendum §AA (PDF not in repo)

use_case.modelled: MLP coincident-peak shaving in ISO-NE (monthly RNS transmission peak + annual FCA capacity peak)
use_case.note: Project's modelled use case; not evidence that any REON CES/EBS is deployed for it.

ebs_use_case.modelled: One 30 kW / 60 kWh EBS-size block (Na+) reduces a commercial facility's monthly demand peak (demand charge)
ebs_use_case.note: PeakSure simulation scenario (peaksure/ebs_scenario.py); not a verified EBS deployment or REON operating profile. REON's EMS lists 'Peak Shaving & Demand Management' (REON CLAIM, https://reoncorp.com/solutions); EBS is for C&I (CONFIRMED).

products.name: REON CESS (Container Energy Storage System)
products.role: White-label container from another vendor (T). Not the product with REON's cell-level BMS.

energy_basis.note: not stated whether nameplate DC, usable, or AC

ac_interface.source: REON_WHO_WE_ARE.pdf as transcribed in PeakSure-Science-Addendum §AA (PDF not in repo)
ac_interface.note: only in the PDF as transcribed; not on the website

cell_level_bypass.source: REON statement to the PeakSure team (hackathon channel)
cell_level_bypass.note: REON: CES is white-label; cell-level control is in EBS

products.name: REON EBS Na+ (Energy Block System, sodium-ion)
products.role: REON's product with the cell-level control BMS (T).

rated_power_kw.note: page heading "EBS | 30kW/60kWh" covers the EBS line, above the Na+/Li+ tabs; assigned to Na+ because Li+ claims >2x energy in the same form factor. AC/DC side not stated

rated_energy_kwh.note: same heading; Na+ assignment as above. Rated vs usable not stated

energy_basis.note: rated vs usable, AC vs DC not stated

cells_per_string.note: ≈ 60 kWh / (3.1 V × 160 Ah); the 160 Ah cell is ASSUMED from another vendor

cell_level_bypass.note: "bypass underperforming cells without shutting down"; S names no product, T assigns it to EBS

nominal_ratio_h.note: 60 kWh / 30 kW; nominal ratio, not a guaranteed AC discharge duration

cycle_life.note: "20,000-Cycle Life" (Na+ tab); no DoD, C-rate, temperature or end-of-life definition

operating_temp.note: "Reliable operation" (Na+ tab); no charge vs discharge limits or power derating given

application.note: "designed for commercial and industrial applications" (EBS line text)

products.name: REON EBS Li+ (Energy Block System, lithium)
products.role: Lithium variant of EBS; cell-level control assumed same as EBS line (T).

rated_power_kw.note: Li+ not separately rated; the 30 kW line heading is not assigned to Li+

rated_energy_kwh.value: more than twice the energy in the same form factor
rated_energy_kwh.note: no base product, conditions or kWh stated; not converted to a model input

application.note: EBS line text; Li+ tab: "sites with high consumption peaks and limited space" (REON CLAIM)

model.name: PeakSure modelled plant (A: conventional; B/C: REON-style bypass)
model.role: Comparison plant for MLP coincident-peak shaving in ISO-NE (project use case).

rated_power_kw.note: comparison size chosen to match the published CESS rating; for B/C ≈ 84 EBS blocks (2500/30), interconnection unknown

rated_energy_kwh.note: treated as DC nameplate; 2.5 MWh (1 h) and 10 MWh (4 h) are hypothetical scenarios

energy_basis.value: DC nameplate; deliverable energy computed at AC after η and switch loss

dc_window_v.note: DC floor enters only via N_min (10% headroom)

chemistry.note: matches EBS Na+; CES chemistry UNKNOWN

cells_per_string.note: conflicts with ≈120 cells per EBS block (DERIVED); topology unknown

switch_r_on.note: switch loss 1% (ASSUMED) × 3.1 V / ≈ 420 A string current

round_trip_eff.note: one-way inverter/conversion efficiency η used for discharge

cell_level_bypass.note: B/C bypass logic is PeakSure's model of REON-style control

nominal_ratio_h.note: 5000 kWh / 2500 kW; a nominal ratio, not a guaranteed AC discharge duration
